ResourceField

class ResourceField(name, kind, builtin_dir, ini_section, ini_key, default, preview_label='', feedback=False, play_button='', required_message='')[source]

Bases: object

One resource field of the player configuration.

Attributes:
namestr

Field name in PlayerKarteaConfig (e.g. “vehicle_image”).

kindstr

KarteaResourceFields.IMAGE or KarteaResourceFields.SOUND.

builtin_dirstr

Folder of the built-in resources (Qt), e.g. “:/images/vehicle”.

ini_sectionstr

kartea.ini section of the default value.

ini_keystr

kartea.ini key of the default value.

defaultstr

Default value when kartea.ini does not have the key.

preview_labelstr

Name shown in the edit screen preview (images). Defaults to “”.

feedbackbool

True for feedback resources (feedback tab and preview). Defaults to False.

play_buttonstr

Button that plays the sound on the edit screen (sounds). Defaults to “”.

required_messagestr

Message when the field is empty in the form (translation source text); empty means an optional field. Fields with the same message produce a single error line. Defaults to “”.

Notes

preview_label and required_message hold pt_BR source texts marked with QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP for pyside6-lupdate; they are translated at display time with self.tr() by the edit screen and its controller (i18n).

Examples

>>> field = KarteaResourceFields.get("vehicle_image")
>>> field.combo_name, field.setting_name
('cbx_vehicle_image', 'VEHICLE_IMAGE')
>>> field.mod_subdir
'images/vehicle'
property required: bool

Whether the field is required (has required_message).

property combo_name: str

Name of the field’s combo box on the edit screen.

property setting_name: str

Name of the matching GameSettings attribute.

property mod_subdir: str

Subfolder of the field inside the mods folder.

Mirrors the built-in folder: “:/images/vehicle” -> “images/vehicle”, “:/sounds/feedback/positive” -> “sounds/feedback/positive”.

property mod_extensions: tuple[str, ...]

Extensions accepted in the mods folder for this field.
